cycles.title: Inherited Refutation and Child-Generation Cycle
cycles.objective: Continue the proof-search organism by deriving new hypotheses from existing nodes while attacking both ancestors and descendants.
decisive_results: A137 destroys H048 through a policy-independent general-Resolution lower bound.
strengthened_results: A139-A140 show that the core of H054 follows from the same resolution-transfer argument under standard CDCL proof logging.
cycles.notes: C007 creates the first machine-enforced inherited hypotheses. H063 is the salvage descendant of destroyed H048 because it changes the proof system to Res(XOR), while H064 is its matching adversarial lower-bound target.
